title: Hamartia — Definition and Role in Tragedy and Poetics
skills: define hamartia in the context of tragedy
identify how errors, flaws, or choices contribute to a tragic downfall
analyze the relationship between hamartia and the tragic hero
apply the concept of hamartia when interpreting dramatic literature
alignment_note: Introduces hamartia as a key concept in tragedy and Aristotelian poetics, examining how a protagonist's error, flaw, or consequential choice can contribute to downfall. Supports analysis of tragic heroes, dramatic causation, characterization, and classical literary theory across high school English courses.
